verdicts.evidence: Sympy symbolic substitution of T_c=T^α into the stated bound yields growth exponent e(α)=2α+1/2, giving the α<1/4 threshold exactly; mutation test removing Ψ changes threshold to α<1/2, matching the paper's Ideal column, confirming the threshold arises from Ψ.

Sympy substitution into the A2 bound yields exponent e(α)=7α/2+1/2, giving α<1/7; mutation test removing Ψ yields α<1/3 matching the paper's Ideal column; Table 1 Matérn entries reproduce to grid resolution.

Exhaustive 1040-config enumeration (10 seeds × 8 indices × 13 magnitudes up to 10¹²) shows RCGP posterior sup-deviation bounded at 1.4212 and converging as |c|→∞ (drift 9.93e-7 between 10⁶ and 10¹²), while standard GP deviation reaches 4.983e+11 and scales linearly in |c|; mutation test disabling P-IMQ yields unbounded deviation.

Symbolic check shows Ψ(0)=1 and both theorem bounds collapse to O(√(Tβ'_Tγ_T)); numeric Forrester benchmark at T_c=0 shows FC and A2 match GP-UCB bit-identically (max query and regret differences = 0.0, mean regret 34.9909 for all three); mutation test violating plateau condition causes divergence on 10/10 seeds.

From-scratch CPU proxy with fixed RBF hyperparameters and grid argmax (not the paper's BoTorch/LOO-CV pipeline); RCGP beats GP-UCB by only 11.4%/5.8%—within one standard error over 10 seeds—and the ordering flips under an alternative endorsed configuration (adaptive T_c estimate: RCGP 793.61 vs GP-UCB 247.37); own DiagnosticsGP implementation disagrees with paper on worst baseline.

overall: The logbook provides solid algebraic and numerical verification of the four theoretical claims (bounds, thresholds, infinite-magnitude tolerance, zero-cost robustness) using sympy derivations, exhaustive posterior-deviation experiments, and bit-identical T_c=0 comparisons, each backed by mutation tests. The experimental claim (Claim 5) is only partially reproduced on a proxy implementation with insufficient seeds and configuration-sensitive results, correctly flagged as a toy.
